# homebridge-google-nest-sdm

A Homebridge plugin for Google Nest devices that uses the Google Smart Device Management API. Supports Cameras, Doorbells, Displays, and Thermostats.  Supports HomeKit Secure Video (please read the section on HKSV below).

**Please read the FAQ before creating an issue.** If you are having trouble with the setup process you can try reaching out to others in Discussions, on Discord, or Reddit, some people there may be able to help.

# Disclaimer

This package is not affiliated with, provided, endorsed, or supported by Google in any way.  It is intended for personal, non-commercial use only.  Please review the Google Smart Device Management Terms of Service to ensure that your usage of this package is not in violation.

# Installation

``npm install -g --unsafe-perm homebridge-google-nest-sdm``

Don't forget the ``--unsafe-perm`` part!

# Example Homebridge config:

    {
        "platform" : "homebridge-google-nest-sdm",
        "clientId": "...",
        "clientSecret": "...",
        "projectId": "...",
        "refreshToken": "...",
        "subscriptionId": "...",
        "gcpProjectId": "<optional>",
        "vEncoder": "<optional>"
        "showFan": "<optional>"
        "fanDuration": "<optional>"
    }

I recommend you use the plugin config UI to enter these values.

# Where do the config values come from?
